title: Microsoft Purview: retention based on last accessed date for SharePoint and OneDrive files (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold for a misleading inventory instruction and conflicting cost statements. The Retention policies page does not list retention labels, and the cost rationale excludes the storage impact acknowledged in the body. The roadmap facts and the narrow gaps in last-accessed documentation are supported.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Retention policies support retain-only, retain-then-delete and delete-only configurations.
claims.quote: You can create a retention policy that just retains content without deleting, retains and then deletes after a specified period of time, or just deletes content after a specified period of time.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: SharePoint and OneDrive retention uses the Preservation Hold library to preserve copies.
claims.quote: But if they edit or delete content that's included in the retention policy, a copy of the content is automatically retained. For SharePoint and OneDrive sites: The copy is retained in the Preservation Hold library.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Preservation Hold library counts towards the site's storage quota.
claims.quote: Because the Preservation Hold library is included in the site's storage quota, you might need to increase your storage when you use retention settings for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 groups.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Learn recommends the Compliance Administrator role group to create and manage retention policies and labels.
claims.quote: To grant permissions for this limited administration, we recommend that you add users to the Compliance Administrator admin role group.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: A role group containing Retention Management is an alternative way to grant retention configuration permissions.
claims.quote: Alternatively to using this default role, you can create a new role group and add the Retention Management role to this group.

claims.claim: A restricted administrator assigned administrative units cannot configure a retention policy that includes SharePoint sites.
claims.quote: If your organization is using administrative units and you're a restricted administrator assigned one or more adminsitrative units, you won't be able to configure a retention policy that includes SharePoint sites or Exchange public folders.

claims.claim: Retention policies apply automatically without per-item approval.
claims.quote:

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches New retention policy, an entry point for choosing the retention-period start.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration, and name your new retention policy.
claims.fix: The path correctly stops at the wizard entry point. Extend controls[0].ui.path for a static policy to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: New-RetentionComplianceRule -Policy <policy name> -ExpirationDateOption ModificationAgeInDays selects last modification as the start for an existing policy's new rule.
claims.quote: The ExpirationDateOption parameter specifies whether the expiration date is calculated from the content creation date or last modification date. Valid values are: CreationAgeInDays; ModificationAgeInDays. The Policy parameter specifies the policy to contain the rule.

claims.claim: The retain/delete configuration is on the 'Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both' wizard page.
claims.quote: For Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both page, specify the configuration options for retaining and deleting content.

claims.claim: A new retention compliance rule is added to an existing policy.
claims.quote: The retention rule must be added to an existing retention policy using the Policy parameter.

claims.claim: No last-accessed retention setting is documented in the portal or automation.
claims.quote: Searched: New-RetentionComplianceRule Set-RetentionComplianceRule New-ComplianceTag last accessed ExpirationDateOption; read all three references, Create and configure retention policies, and Create retention labels for exceptions to your retention policies. No last-accessed setting found.

claims.claim: Retention configuration permissions do not require access to the content.
claims.quote: For a read-only role, use View-Only Retention Management. These permissions are required only to create, configure, and apply retention policies and retention labels. The person configuring these policies and labels doesn't require access to the content.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout, first bullet
claims.claim: Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies is where administrators can inventory retention labels.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Retention labels.
claims.fix: Remove 'and labels' from the first Before rollout bullet, leaving 'Inventory the retention policies that already cover SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts in the Microsoft Purview portal (Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies), so overlaps are known before a new option appears.' The existing controls row then covers the instruction without adding another row.

claims.claim: The cost rationale says admin time is the only cost the sources show, but the body also identifies retained-content storage.
claims.quote: Rationale: 'The only cost the sources show is admin time'. Body: 'The cost the sources show is admin time to design and test policies, plus storage in the Preservation Hold library where content is retained.'
claims.fix: Replace the cost rationale with 'Low. Admin time is needed to design and test policies, and retained content can increase storage usage in the Preservation Hold library; a licence or price specific to this option is not yet published.' Keep the low rating.

claims.claim: View-Only Retention Management is the read-only retention role.
claims.quote: For a read-only role, use View-Only Retention Management.

claims.claim: The retention rule reference lists CreationAgeInDays and ModificationAgeInDays as the valid ExpirationDateOption values.
claims.quote: The ExpirationDateOption parameter specifies whether the expiration date is calculated from the content creation date or last modification date. Valid values are: CreationAgeInDays; ModificationAgeInDays
